questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for farm machinery in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross the road ahead. Drive carefully and watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings). It alerts drivers that a steep hill is ahead. Be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be present in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that a playground is nearby. Watch for children who may be on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Be prepared to slow down if you are following them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway ahead from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to special situations or hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Slow down as you enter and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow sign with black markings warns that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and increase the distance between your vehicle and others.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an intersection is coming. Look carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. At this location, railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The underside of low-clearance vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells drivers that construction ahead will change the normal road route. Be prepared to follow a redirected path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that area. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit depending on conditions. When roads or weather are poor, slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign marks reserved parking spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves. Reduce your speed accordingly.
